reply.text:
I can't give you a number on that, and not because of the rules: dosing steroids is medical territory, and the right call depends on bloodwork and your health, not a percentage I pull out of the air. A doctor, ideally one who works with athletes and will run labs before and during, is the person for it.

What I can do is keep the training side tight, so your lifting is dialed in whatever you decide. Want me to look at where your main lifts are sitting right now?
